title: Which source wins for which question?
summary: A compact authority map prevents an emulator trace, old manual, obsolete RFC, or current IBM i setting from being mistaken for universal protocol truth.

map.question: current IBM i command/configuration/host behaviour
map.primary: IBM Documentation for exact IBM i release

map.question: observed PUB400 or other host behaviour
map.constraint: observation does not override protocol authority; record host/release/context

authority: project authority doctrine derived from referenced primary-source relationships
